coverage_notes: EXHAUSTIVE survey across market/competitive landscape for UX teardown of internal tools and low-code platforms (Retool, Appsmith, Budibase, Airtable, NocoDB). Coverage angles: (1) Market sizing & CAGR: Gartner/Forrester analyst reports, IDC forecasts, workflow automation market data; (2) Primary product capture: Official pricing pages, documentation, GitHub repositories with real star counts for open-source projects; (3) Review aggregates: G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Gartner Peer Insights with verified user ratings; (4) Funding/company data: Crunchbase funding rounds, competitive positioning; (5) Comparative landscape: Head-to-head product comparisons, feature matrices, user experience analyses; (6) Enterprise adoption: McKinsey/Deloitte digital transformation surveys, citizen developer statistics, ROI data; (7) Academic/research: arXiv papers on low-code/no-code platforms, HCI implications; (8) Practitioner coverage: High-quality blog posts, case studies, open-source ecosystem reports. Deduplication applied across 100+ initial search results. Tier distribution: T0 (17 primary sources), T1 (12 official docs), T2 (8 analyst reports and review platforms), T3 (11 practitioner essays and high-quality guides).
